fixture.scope: same-runtime redundant DELETE key predicate comparison
fixture.methodology: Fresh private volumes per mode. Both modes install the same core extension, roles, publication, grants and one pgduck engine; only mirroring starts a subscription. One persistent application psql session. Two-second CPU/memory and publication observers run in both modes. Mirror progress uses published source XIDs in the local journal; there are no recurring Iceberg data scans. The bounded fresh-database experiment rejects source XID wrap. CPU is cgroup usage including container observer overhead; host/controller/storage CPU is excluded. RSS double counts shared pages; PSS apportions them. Memory samples include caches. Publication latency is an observed upper bound with sampling and query delay, not exact commit-to-Iceberg latency. All S3 activity under the fixture iceberg prefix is final mirror output; the local trace labels that prefix local_mirror. No intermediate capture logs exist. No global cache clearing or production acceptance threshold. Comparison uses identical runtime image, 1-second coalescing, INSERT grouping enabled, journal count 32 and default byte limit. Remote source is plain PostgreSQL from the same image, with no replication extension or engine loaded. Destination retains unused empty source-fixture heaps; these are not selected by its receiver. One engine in either topology. All containers run on this host; no WAN simulation. Remote has an additional resource-sampling call; observer CPU is included. Final comparisons are outside the measured interval.

object_operations.scope: observed fixture S3 requests by object prefix; bucket-wide requests remain separate

methodology: Same cached binary image in all fresh fixtures; candidate installs only migration 0033 before snapshot/start. 120 transactions at 4 offered tx/s, paired INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, four inserted rows/table/transaction. Initial seed copy excluded from measurement. Reversed mode order on second repetition. Observers, batching and journal limits identical. No diagnostic wrappers or extra worker timing phases. CPU excludes host/controller/storage. Short local descriptive comparison, not production sizing or confidence intervals.
